name: Jonathan Harker
source:
The Second Chance

A partner at Hawkins & Harker law firm, former classmate and current boss of Renfield. After years of avoiding each other—and their mutual attraction—the pair are reunited. Can they address their feelings before they meet their doom?

Rekindle an old flame with Jonny, and burn Dracula's nocturnal empire to ashes.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1712125696/draculesti]Kickstarter[/url]]
